name: local-context-forge-desktop
description: Local Context Forge Electron desktop trust boundary

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && npm run audit:python-sidecar && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run audit:python-sidecar && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
